mutations.name: a .github/ file with no structural reader reads as budget
mutations.find: return { why: `${shownLine(file.path)} is not the budget data file or a workflow, so its change is not read as budget` };
kills: judging a weakened CI-policy diff by its parsed structure reads a .github/ file with no structural reader beside a budget bump as weakening

mutations.name: a workflow key outside its jobs may change
mutations.find: if (!isDeepStrictEqual(without(base, "jobs"), without(head, "jobs"))) return why("more than its jobs' timeouts");
kills: judging a weakened CI-policy diff by its parsed structure reads a workflow by its parsed structure, so a top-level timeout-minutes is weakening

mutations.name: a timeout may be removed or set to anything
kills: judging a weakened CI-policy diff by its parsed structure reads a workflow by its parsed structure, so a removed timeout is weakening
